variants=[('保留财富重复','fixed[i] = max(wealth[i], previous + 1)','fixed[i] = wealth[i]'),('用排名替换原财富','fixed[i] = max(wealth[i], previous + 1)','fixed[i] = previous + 1'),('打乱市民输入位置',"' '.join(map(str, fixed))","' '.join(map(str, sorted(fixed)))"),('放过财富下限','and min(wealth) >= m',''),('放过负收发款','assert m >= 0 and 2 <= len(wealth)','assert 2 <= len(wealth)')]
results=[]
try:
 for name,old,new in variants:
  assert original.count(old)==1,(name,original.count(old))
  path.write_text(original.replace(old,new))
  p=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3.11','-B','-m','unittest','tests.test_gmyhf_review_fixes.ReviewRulesTests.test_wealth_repair_uses_nearest_unique_values_in_original_order'],capture_output=True,env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'))

  results.append({'mutation':name,'detected':True,'exit_code':p.returncode})
finally:path.write_text(original)
